summary: Kiro for Startups gives early-stage to Series A startups up to one year of Kiro Pro+ credits in three tiers (Starter ≤2 users, Growth ≤10, Scale ≤30). Applications are open April 7 – December 31, 2026. Requires an AWS Account ID with a business email matching the startup's domain; startups holding active AWS Activate credits are not eligible. Applicants must be 18 or older. Excluded residences: Argentina, Belarus, Brazil, China/GCR, Cuba, France, Germany, Iran, Italy, Mexico, North Korea, Poland, Russia, Spain, Syria, the region of Crimea, the so-called Donetsk People's Republic region (DNR), the so-called Luhansk People's Republic region (LNR), and the United Arab Emirates. Credits deposit to the AWS account on approval and expire 1 year after issuance; redeeming requires login via AWS IAM Identity Center. Choosing a plan above Pro+ or exceeding tier users can incur charges. Once credits are depleted, the AWS account automatically switches to standard Kiro Pro+ monthly billing on its card; continued use after expiry can also incur charges.
claim_steps: Confirm early-stage to Series A eligibility, age 18+, and residence outside the excluded locations listed above (including France and Germany); active AWS Activate credit holders are not eligible.
Apply at aws.amazon.com/startups/credits/kiro with your AWS Account ID and business email matching your startup domain.
Choose a tier: Starter (≤2 users), Growth (≤10) or Scale (≤30).
On approval, credits are deposited to the AWS account and activate on provisioning.
Access Kiro via AWS IAM Identity Center (not Builder ID or social logins) to redeem credits.

Stay within the chosen tier and Pro+ plan. Monitor credits and stop/cancel unwanted billable access before depletion or expiry: standard Kiro Pro+ monthly billing starts automatically when credits run out.

social_proof.title: Kiro for startups
social_proof.text: For a limited time only, early stage to Series A startups globally can apply for up to 1-year’s worth of free Kiro Pro+ at three-tiered options. Startups with active AWS Activate Credits are not eligible for this promotion.

social_proof.title: Kiro Pro+ promotional offer terms and conditions
social_proof.text: Offer is only valid for individuals 18 years and older. Excludes individuals living in Argentina, Belarus, Brazil, China/GCR, Cuba, France, Germany, Iran, Italy, Mexico, North Korea, Poland, Russia, Spain, Syria, the region of Crimea, the so-called Donetsk People's Republic region (DNR), the so-called Luhansk People's Republic region (LNR), and the United Arab Emirates.

social_proof.title: Startup plan and user-tier overage conditions
social_proof.text: If you select a plan greater than Kiro Pro+ upon receiving credits or exceed the number of users for the package tier you selected, you may be charged additional fees.

social_proof.title: Automatic standard Pro+ monthly billing
social_proof.text: Once you have used all Kiro credits provided under this promotion, your AWS Account will automatically switch to standard Kiro Pro+ billing at the then-current billing rates and billed to the credit card associated with your AWS Account on a monthly basis.
